title: Звірка та приймання пакета
fields_and_relations: Маніфест, вихідні назви, revision елементів, checksum і комплектність.
required_interaction: Прийняти/повернути елементи; дефект або відсутня копія → завдання, не фальшивий успіх.

implementation.view_model: Check items; send/return/accept with explicit recipient rights; missing independent copies block acceptance
limitations: Transport is local simulation; no network delivery.
implementation.state_storage: Shared normalized browser store, fixture version 3; incremental migration preserves prior user changes
permissions: media.write / physical.write / intake.send / intake.receive / legacy.write / legacy.review / capture.field, explicit archive grants
implementation.atomicity: Authorize and compare expected revision/package state; mutate clone; validate FK/type/version/hash; commit atomically.
